subtitle: 치명타를 향한 보기의 숭고한 민첩 철학

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
알카즈 감옥 민첩 반지다!
이건 당연히 냥꾼 거지~
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. Centered Dwarf Hunter cheerfully holds up a tiny sparkling emerald-and-silver agility ring with her wooden blunderbuss gun stowed neatly on her back, while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub beside her claps its paws with sparkling eyes.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
잠깐, 보기님!
민첩 반지에 왜 입찰하세요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium side-angled two-shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Undead Paladin with her one-handed mace and golden shield stowed on her back calmly tosses a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube with round dot pips only (no digits); on the right, Dwarf Hunter (gun stowed on back) leans forward pointing in disbelief while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub tilts its head in confusion.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
논란이 많은 건 알지만
기사도 치명타엔 민첩이야.
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic low-angle close-up in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Centered Undead Paladin looks down with sleepy half-lidded eyes and a completely deadpan serious face, one hand resting calmly on her chin with her mace and shield stowed on her back.

Massive bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of the frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background. Dwarf Hunter on the left with her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub peeking up beside her, and Skyborne Mage on the right, all frozen in speechless blank-eyed jaw-dropped shock with tiny comic sweat drops and stunned lines around their heads.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
그럼 나도 힘 반지 굴린다?
지팡이 치명타 터지게.
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the right character in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Skyborne Mage with her crystal orb staff stowed on her back puts both hands on her hips and glares fiercely with puffed cheeks at Undead Paladin on the right, who calmly inspects the tiny agility ring with her mace and shield stowed.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
내 민첩… 내 치명타…
그냥 여기서 죽척할래…
cuts.visual_prompt: Wide-angle aftermath shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD comic style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal floor shadow. On the left, Undead Paladin walks away calmly carrying her golden shield and one-handed mace; on the right, Dwarf Hunter (gun stowed on back) lies flat sprawled face-down on the floor in a classic Feign Death flop right beside her cute 2.5-head chibi SD baby brown bear cub flopped flat in solidarity.
